alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway. Two small block figures with white eyes, an ink-black one on the left and a royal blue one on the right. They go back and forth: it's left, no, right, it's left. The black one narrows its eyes, then stretches up with wide eyes and a bubble says you were right. The blue one answers told you! with happy eyes and a pulse. The text stays: me saying you were right. The last card: Choose friction.
